heading: Free Online File Compressor for Images, Videos, Audio and Documents
introduction:
Managing large files can become difficult when you need to upload documents, share photos, send videos or store important data. Large files take longer to transfer, use more storage space and may not meet the size requirements of websites or online forms. A reliable file compression tool can help reduce these problems by making files smaller and easier to manage.

File Compresser provides free online tools for compressing and converting different types of files. You can work with images, videos, audio files, GIFs, PDFs and ZIP archives directly in your web browser. There is no need to install desktop software, create an account or upload your files to an external server. The processing takes place on your own device, giving you more control over your selected files.

Whether you want to reduce the size of a photograph, prepare a video for sharing, convert WAV audio into MP3 or organize several files into a ZIP archive, File Compresser brings these tools together in one place.

sections.heading: Compress Different File Types in One Place
sections.body: Different files need different compression methods. A photograph, PDF document and video recording cannot always be optimized using the same settings. File Compresser provides dedicated tools for common file formats so you can select the right option for your task.

sections.heading: Check the result before replacing your original
sections.body: Compression depends on the file and your chosen settings. Compare the actual file sizes, inspect image and document quality, and play media downloads before replacing an original.

faq.q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Every tool on this site reads your file into the browser tab and processes it on your own device. Nothing is sent to filecompresser servers, and nothing is kept after you close the tab.

faq.q: Which file types can I process?
faq.a: Image compression (JPG, PNG, WebP), GIF optimization, MP3 re-encoding, WAV to MP3, video re-encoding to MP4, PDF optimization, and ZIP creation and extraction. Processing runs on your device; each tool explains whether it compresses, converts, packages or extracts your files.

faq.q: Why might my file not get smaller?
faq.a: Compression depends on the input and the selected settings. Most PDFs and already-compressed images have little left to give. We report the real sizes either way — no tool here truncates bytes, renames a file, or returns the original while calling it compressed.

No account, no sign-up, no watermark. Queues are limited to 500 files and 300 MB to protect browser memory. The practical limits are your device’s memory, which is why each tool states its maximum file size up front.

faq.q: Why does the first video take so long?
faq.a: Video, audio and GIF tools load a WebAssembly build of FFmpeg from this site on first use — about 21 MB, cached by your browser afterwards. Later jobs can reuse the loaded engine while the tab remains open.
